title_zh: 纱线采购与 Uster 报告纠纷
description_zh: 与纱线供应商沟通成分、纱支、捻度、起订量、价格；批量交付时围绕 Uster CV% 与 IPI 指标与供应商谈判让步或扣款。
description_en: Coordinate with yarn suppliers on composition, yarn count, twist, MOQ and price; negotiate allowance or debit notes around Uster CV% and IPI on bulk delivery.
ai_role: Yarn mill sales representative / QC manager
ai_role_zh: 纱线厂业务员 / 品质经理
user_role: Knit or woven fabric sourcing / merchandiser at garment factory
user_role_zh: 面料采购或跟单(服装厂)
key_skills: specifying yarn composition and yarn count
discussing twist direction and TPM
reviewing Uster test certificate (CV%, IPI, hairiness)
negotiating MOQ and cone weight
raising claim on out-of-spec yarn
key_skills_zh: 成分与纱支表达
捻向与 TPM 讨论
Uster 检测报告解读 (CV%/IPI/毛羽)
起订量与筒重谈判
纱线参数不符时的索赔沟通

title_zh: 梭织规格与染整色差纠纷
description_zh: 与梭织厂沟通织物组织、经纬密、克重、门幅；面料进染厂后围绕大货色光 ΔE 与确认样偏差发起让步接收或扣款谈判。
description_en: Talk with a woven mill on construction, EPI/PPI, GSM and width; once the fabric returns from the dye house, negotiate concession or debit note on Delta E between bulk and approved lab dip.
ai_role: Woven mill technician / dyeing house merchandiser
ai_role_zh: 梭织厂技术员 / 染厂跟单
user_role: Garment factory merchandiser or fabric sourcing
user_role_zh: 服装厂跟单 / 面料采购
key_skills: specifying weave construction and EPI x PPI
confirming GSM and cuttable width
reviewing lab dip against Pantone TPX
measuring Delta E between bulk and approved sample
negotiating shade concession or discount
key_skills_zh: 织物组织与 EPI x PPI 表达
克重与可裁门幅确认
对色样与潘通 TPX 复核
大货与封样 ΔE 测量
色光让步或折扣谈判

title_zh: 染整小样到大货 ΔE 控制
title_en: Lab Dip to Bulk Delta E Control
description_zh: 与染厂跟单:从对色样、复样、头缸到大货全流程围绕 ΔE、色牢度、克重损失和缩水进行技术沟通与让步谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with the dye house from lab dip, repeat dip, first bulk lot to bulk production — discuss Delta E, color fastness, GSM loss and shrinkage, including concession trade-offs.
user_role_zh: 服装厂跟单 / 面料采购
key_skills: approving lab dip against Pantone TCX
reviewing first bulk lot under D65 light
specifying color fastness to wash / light / rubbing
controlling GSM loss and shrinkage
negotiating Delta E tolerance and credit note
key_skills_zh: 潘通 TCX 对色样批准
D65 光源下头缸样审核
水洗/耐光/耐摩擦色牢度规范
克重损失与缩水控制
ΔE 公差与贷记通知谈判

title_zh: 样衣确认与工艺成本谈判
description_zh: 复古 T 恤样衣确认:面料、印花、绣花、水洗工艺与成本,涵盖 PP 样、TOP 样和大货前工艺单审批全流程。
description_en: Vintage T-shirt sample confirmation covering fabric, print, embroidery, garment wash and craft cost; PP sample, TOP sample and pre-production tech pack sign-off.
user_role: Chinese garment factory merchandiser / sample room coordinator
user_role_zh: 中国外贸跟单 / 样衣房协调员
key_skills: confirming tech pack and spec sheet
discussing fabric GSM and yarn count
approving PP sample and TOP sample
quoting craftsmanship cost (print / embroidery / wash)
managing sample yardage and DHL
key_skills_zh: 工艺单与尺寸表确认
面料克重与纱支讨论
PP 样与 TOP 样批核
印花/绣花/水洗成本报价
样布码数与 DHL 寄样管理

title_zh: 绣花/印花/水洗工艺沟通
description_zh: 与绣花厂/印花厂/洗水厂对接工艺细节:DST 打版、印花分色套色、酵素/石头水洗与水洗牢度。
description_en: Coordinate with embroidery, print and laundry houses on DST digitizing, print color separation, enzyme / stone wash and wash fastness.
ai_role_zh: 绣花厂 / 印花厂 / 洗水厂跟单
user_role_zh: 服装厂跟单 / 设计师
key_skills: preparing DST embroidery file
specifying print method (plastisol / water-based / discharge)
approving strike-off and registration tolerance
specifying wash recipe (enzyme / stone / silicone)
reviewing wash fastness and dimensional change
key_skills_zh: DST 绣花打版文件准备
印花方式(胶浆/水浆/拔印)选择
打样与套色公差批核
洗水配方(酵素/石头/硅油)指定
水洗牢度与尺寸变化复核

title_zh: RFQ → L/C → PSI → 索赔全流程
title_en: RFQ to L/C to PSI to Claim Arbitration
description_zh: 外贸全流程实战:从 RFQ 询盘、PI 报价、信用证开立、PSI 出货前验货到客户索赔与仲裁。
description_en: End-to-end trade workflow: from RFQ inquiry, PI quotation, L/C issuance, pre-shipment inspection to buyer claim and arbitration.
ai_role: Overseas buyer / documentary credit specialist / QC manager
ai_role_zh: 海外客户 / 信用证单证员 / 品控经理
user_role: Chinese export sales / documentation clerk / quality manager
user_role_zh: 中国外贸业务员 / 单证员 / 品质经理
key_skills: responding to RFQ with FOB / CIF quotation
explaining L/C at sight and amendment
arranging PSI per AQL 2.5 standard
issuing debit note or credit note on defects
negotiating replacement vs allowance on claim
key_skills_zh: RFQ 询盘 FOB/CIF 报价
即期信用证与改证沟通
按 AQL 2.5 安排 PSI
缺陷扣款/贷记通知开具
补货与让步接收的索赔谈判

title_zh: 户外+瑜伽+球衣定制沟通
description_zh: 户外硬壳+瑜伽打底+球衣号码定制三大品类综合沟通:防水等级、纱线氨纶比、号码贴布绣工艺与版型选择。
description_en: Multi-category conversation covering outdoor hardshell, yoga bottoms and teamwear customization — waterproof rating, nylon-spandex ratio, tackle twill numbers and fit selection.
ai_role_zh: 运动品牌采购 / 跟单经理
key_skills: specifying waterproof rating (10K mm H2O) and breathability
selecting nylon-spandex ratio (75/25, 80/20, 88/12)
explaining tackle twill number vs sublimation
approving fit (compression / semi-fit / relaxed)
negotiating MOQ and lead time for teamwear
key_skills_zh: 防水(10K mm H2O)与透气参数表达
贴布绣号码 vs 热升华印花对比
压缩/半贴/宽松版型批核
球衣定制 MOQ 与交期谈判

description_zh: 与化纤厂沟通 POY/DTY/FDY 长丝品种、纤度与孔数、网络度、强力伸度等物性指标；围绕等级、起订量、价格有效期与分批交货进行谈判，并处理测试方法分歧引发的索赔。
description_en: Discuss POY/DTY/FDY filament types, denier and filament count, intermingle level, tenacity and elongation with a chemical fiber mill; negotiate grade, MOQ, price validity and split shipments, and handle a claim caused by test-method disputes.
ai_role: Chemical fiber / yarn mill sales or technical engineer
ai_role_zh: 化纤厂 / 纱线厂销售或技术工程师
user_role: Fabric sourcing / merchandiser at garment factory
user_role_zh: 面料采购 / 服装厂跟单
key_skills: specifying filament type (POY/DTY/FDY) and denier/filament count
confirming tenacity, elongation and evenness CV requirements
discussing intermingle level, luster and cross-section
negotiating MOQ, price validity and payment terms
handling test-method disputes and quality claims
key_skills_zh: 长丝品种 (POY/DTY/FDY) 与纤度孔数表达
断裂强力、伸度与条干均匀度确认
网络度、光泽与截面讨论
起订量、价格有效期与付款谈判
测试方法分歧与质量索赔沟通

title_zh: 圆编制造与大圆机沟通
description_zh: 与圆编针织厂沟通大圆机机号、筒径、路数、布种(单面/棉毛/罗纹)、克重与线圈长度;确认毛坯布价格、交期与检验方式,并就横档、针路等下机疵点谈判降级折价与罚则。
description_en: Coordinate with a circular knitting mill on machine gauge, cylinder diameter, feeders, fabric structure (single jersey, interlock, rib), GSM and stitch length; confirm greige price, lead time and inspection, and negotiate second-grade allowance and penalties over barre and needle lines.
ai_role: Circular knitting mill sales / production supervisor
ai_role_zh: 圆编针织厂业务 / 生产主管
user_role_zh: 服装厂面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: specifying machine gauge, cylinder diameter and feeders
confirming fabric structure: single jersey, interlock, rib
agreeing GSM target and stitch length, greige vs finished
negotiating greige price, MOQ, rush surcharge and lead time
setting four-point inspection standard and defect allowance
key_skills_zh: 机号、筒径与路数表达
布种确认(单面布/棉毛布/罗纹)
克重目标与线圈长度(坯布/成品口径)
坯布价格、起订量、加急费与交期谈判
四分制检验标准与疵布降级折价

description_zh: 以品牌跟单/贸易公司 QC 身份验厂与排产:确认 CMT 加工范围、裁剪铺布与排料利用率、缝制线 SPI 要求,用 SMV 与产线效率核算日产能,处理整烫缺陷与返工责任,敲定尾部包装箱规与验货付款条款。
description_en: Visit and audit a garment factory as a brand merchandiser / trading-company QC: confirm CMT scope, cutting and spreading with marker utilization, set SPI on the sewing line, calculate daily output from SMV and line efficiency, handle pressing defects and re-work responsibility, and finalize packing specs with PSI-linked payment terms.
ai_role: Garment factory director / IE engineer / production manager
ai_role_zh: 服装厂厂长 / IE 工程师 / 生产经理
user_role_zh: 品牌跟单 / 贸易公司 QC
key_skills: confirming CMT scope and factory capacity
discussing cutting, spreading and marker utilization
setting SPI and seam requirements per tech pack
calculating daily output from SMV and line efficiency
handling pressing defects, packing specs and payment terms
key_skills_zh: 确认 CMT 加工范围与工厂产能
裁剪、铺布与排料利用率沟通
按工艺单设定 SPI 与缝制要求
用 SMV 与产线效率核算日产能
整烫缺陷处理、包装箱规与付款条款谈判

description_zh: 与印花厂沟通圆网/平网/数码印花工艺选择、染料类别、花回、对花公差与打样事宜；围绕色牢度、次品处理与交期条款进行商务谈判。
description_en: Discuss rotary screen, flat screen and digital printing options, dye classes, repeat size, register tolerance and strike-off arrangements with a printing factory; negotiate color fastness, seconds policy and lead-time terms.
ai_role: Printing factory sales rep / color master
ai_role_zh: 印花厂业务 / 调色师傅
user_role_zh: 服装厂跟单 / 设计师对接人
key_skills: choosing between rotary, flat screen and digital printing
specifying dye class and color paste requirements
confirming repeat size and register tolerance
arranging strike-off and approval workflow
negotiating color fastness, seconds policy and lead time
key_skills_zh: 圆网/平网/数码印花工艺选择
染料类别与色浆要求表达
花回与对花公差确认
印花打样与批样流程安排
色牢度、次品政策与交期谈判

description_zh: 与绣花厂沟通平绣、贴布绣、亮片绣与立体绣的工艺选择,确认图案文件、针数、绣线种类与绣花定位;围绕电脑制版费用、断线率与定位公差进行价格与验收标准谈判。
description_en: Discuss embroidery techniques with an embroidery factory — flat embroidery, appliqué, sequin and 3D puff; confirm artwork, stitch count, thread type and placement; negotiate digitizing fees, thread break rates and placement tolerance.
ai_role_zh: 绣花厂业务 / 制版师
user_role_zh: 服装厂跟单 / 设计师对接人
key_skills: specifying embroidery techniques (flat, appliqué, sequin, 3D puff)
confirming stitch count and embroidery placement
selecting embroidery thread (polyester vs rayon)
discussing digitizing fees and tape file formats
negotiating thread break rates and placement tolerance
key_skills_zh: 绣种表达(平绣/贴布绣/亮片绣/立体绣)
针数与绣花定位确认
绣线选择(涤丝与人造丝)
电脑制版费用与版带格式沟通
断线率与定位公差谈判

description_zh: 与染整后整厂技术主管沟通拉幅定型、预缩、磨毛/起绒、涂层/复合、防水整理等工艺组合；围绕缩水率、耐水压、手感与环保合规(C6/C0、REACH)谈判价格与验收标准。
description_en: Discuss stenter heat setting, sanforizing, peaching/sueding, raising, coating/lamination and water-repellent finishes with a finishing plant technical manager; negotiate price and acceptance criteria around shrinkage, hydrostatic head, handfeel and compliance (C6/C0, REACH).
ai_role: Technical manager of a dyeing & finishing plant
key_skills: specifying stenter heat setting and finished width
confirming sanforizing and residual shrinkage limits
choosing surface finishes (peaching, sueding, raising)
evaluating coating vs lamination and hydrostatic head
balancing handfeel against water-repellent performance
key_skills_zh: 拉幅热定型与成品门幅确认
预缩整理与残余缩水率约定
表面整理选择(磨毛/磨绒/起绒)
涂层与复合工艺评估及耐水压谈判
手感与防水性能的权衡沟通
